comparison.objective: Squeeze spring tongs shut, pull their locking tab and store them in a tray slot.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual spring closure plus tab actuation, followed by placement in a constrained compartment.
comparison.success_condition: Tab at least 7 mm out, arms within 0.03 rad of shut, released in the long compartment for two seconds.
comparison.reason: Tests closing and latching an articulated utensil; it has no aligned impact, sacrificial fracture, retained insert or fragment accounting.
